parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the database instance.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The node ID.

> Required for PolarDB for MySQL cluster instances.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The source of the analysis task:

- **MANUAL** or **not specified**: queries the recent deadlock analysis task.

- **AUTO**: queries the full deadlock analysis task.

parameters.name: TextId
parameters.description: The ID of the deadlock text. This value is returned from the GetDeadLockHistory operation.
